units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 3:5">Dem. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 6b:1">Ḥull. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>הנותן לפ׳ שלו</he> if one gives to his hostess (provisions to prepare).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:7">Yeb. XVI, 7</cite> <he>ובחזרתן אמרו לפ׳ וכ׳</he> and when they came back, they asked the (gentile) innkeeper.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא תהא כהנת כפ׳</he> should a priest’s wife not be as good (an evidence) as that innkeeper? <he>לכשתהא כפ׳</he> when she will be (offering such evidence) as that innkeeper; Tosef. Yeb. end <he>לכשתהא פ׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:2">Esth. R. to I, 9</cite> (proverbial expression) <he>לא תהא כהנת כפ׳</he> should the priest’s wife &c., i.e. should the Lord not be at least as much revered as the idols?; Lam. R. introd. (R. Yitsḥ. 3); a. e.
